answer: When an AI agent registers a new identity it must stake a marble token of native currency into a time‑locked vault, and the network records the stake with an umber‑coded hash linking it to a unique key. Reward tokens vest at 1% per day, so a farm of Sybils accrues payouts only after a waiting period; any early withdrawal forfeits the locked marble token. Thus an attacker pays a marble token per fake identity and endures a 30‑day lock‑up, making large‑scale Sybil attacks costly and keeping the harbor of honest agents safe.
